input:
On our ARMv9 platform with DSU-120 L3 cache, we observe two issues that seem related:
1. L3 cache slice 2 power consumption is 40% higher than other slices at idle
2. DVFS transitions on the big cluster are overshooting target voltage by 15-20mV

Power rail measurements:
  VDD_DSU: expected 0.75V idle, measured 0.81V (slice 2 contributing)
  VDD_BIG: target 0.80V @ 1.8GHz, measured 0.82V
  VDD_BIG: target 0.65V @ 1.0GHz, measured 0.67V

DSU PMU counters:
  L3D_CACHE_REFILL (slice 0): 142,301
  L3D_CACHE_REFILL (slice 1): 139,877
  L3D_CACHE_REFILL (slice 2): 891,204  <-- anomalous
  L3D_CACHE_REFILL (slice 3): 140,550

ftrace DVFS transitions:
  <idle>-0  [004] 100.200: cpu_frequency: state=1800000 cpu_id=4
  <idle>-0  [004] 100.201: regulator_set_voltage: name=vdd_big min=800000 max=800000
  <idle>-0  [004] 100.204: regulator_set_voltage_complete: name=vdd_big val=820000

Are these related? Is the L3 slice leak causing DVFS calibration issues?
